ui_refresh_updates: Refresh official package indexes to check for available updates?
ui_confirm_updates: Apply the displayed updates? Existing configuration will be kept. Package removals and distribution upgrades are not allowed here.
ui_no_updates: No applicable updates found. Held packages may need separate review.
ui_plan_missing: No reviewed package plan exists. Prepare the operation again.
ui_plan_changed: APT changed the package plan after review. Nothing was applied. Review a new plan before continuing.
ui_update_removal_blocked: The update would remove packages. MOS blocked it; review dependencies manually.
ui_database_exists: This site already has database {database}. Credentials remain in its private .database.json file.
ui_expiring_certificates: Some certificates expire within 30 days. Open the inventory to review them.
websites.description: Choose a domain to manage its files, PHP, certificates, Git deployment and SSH/SFTP access.
ui_software.description: Install the web stack, select packages and review system updates before applying them.
ui_security_access.description: SSH keys and ports, firewall rules, intrusion protection and certificates.
backups.description: Encrypted remote backups, schedules and recovery into a separate directory.
view_performance.description: Live resource use, hourly history and running services.
make_a_speed_test.description: Measure download, upload and latency using speedtest-cli.
ui_settings.description: Server defaults, language, activity history and application removal.
about.description: Project information, author and the full MIT license.
exit.description: Close MOS ITC. Your services keep running.
install_web_server.description: Default Apache/PHP/MariaDB stack or a custom package selection.
ui_package_updates.description: APT simulates the update. MOS checks that the plan remains unchanged before installing it.
create_website.description: Create a domain with its own Linux account and optional PHP and database.
ui_resize_terminal: Resize terminal to 58 columns × 20 rows. Esc: back.
ui_ssh_unknown_socket: Cannot determine the SSH socket bind addresses. No port change was applied.
ui_ssh_unsafe_restart: SSH socket restart could terminate sessions on this host. Review its KillMode before changing the port.
ui_no_restore_points: No installer restore points exist yet.
ui_extract_restore_point: Extract restore point {name} to {target}? Live configuration is not overwritten. Review recovered files before restoring services.
ui_invalid_restore_point: Invalid restore point or archive path
ui_restore_point_target: Select an existing restore point and a NEW recovery directory.
cert_file_required: Select a regular PEM file, not a directory or device.
cert_file_too_large: A certificate/key field cannot exceed 1 MiB.
cert_file_unreadable: Cannot read this file as UTF-8 PEM. Check the path, permissions and format.
cert_expected_certificate: Paste only BEGIN CERTIFICATE / END CERTIFICATE blocks. A CSR, public key or private key does not belong in this field.
cert_expected_private_key: Provide a PEM private key: BEGIN PRIVATE KEY, BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY or BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY.
cert_encrypted_key: This key is encrypted. Unattended Apache needs an unencrypted PEM key; MOS stores it with root-only permissions.
cert_import_file: Import a file from this server
cert_certificate_help: Domain certificate supplied by your provider (.crt or .pem). Include BEGIN CERTIFICATE and END CERTIFICATE. Fullchain PEM is accepted: MOS separates its intermediates automatically. Do not paste a CSR or private key.
cert_key_help: Matching private key, not the public key. RSA, EC and PKCS#8 PEM are supported. Include the BEGIN/END lines. Its contents never appear in the review or task log.
cert_chain_help: Optional intermediate CA bundle: one or more BEGIN CERTIFICATE blocks. Leave empty if intermediates are already in your fullchain or not required by your CA. Existing intermediates are retained when editing.
cert_review_help: MOS verifies the certificate/key pair, trust chain, validity and all websites already using this label. Review public details before saving. Changes stay in memory until you apply them.
cert_required_fields: Load the certificate and its private key first. The intermediate chain is optional.
cert_validation_failed: The certificate was not saved. Check the selected files and intermediate chain. Your draft remains available for correction. Private CA roots must be trusted by the system explicitly.
admin_users.description: Create local SSH users with full sudo access. Manage administrator passwords and public keys.
users_password: New account password (also used for sudo)
users_password_invalid: Use a password of 8–256 characters without line breaks or NUL bytes.
users_reserved_name: The mos_ prefix is reserved for website service accounts.
users_account_exists: This account, home directory or MOS sudo policy already exists. Choose another name; no existing account was replaced.
users_key_required: SSH password authentication is disabled on this server. Add a public key to connect; the account password will still be used for sudo.
users_select_local_admin: Select a local, non-root administrator from the list.
users_install_dependencies: Install the required sudo/OpenSSH packages before creating an administrator?
users_add_key: Add an SSH public key to this account?
users_confirm_create: Create {username} with a home directory, SSH shell and full sudo administrator permissions? Sudo will request the account password.
users_created:
Administrator {username} created.

Connect from your computer using the real server IP/domain:
  ssh -p {port} {username}@SERVER_IP

Then open the control panel:
  sudo mos-itc

Use the account password when sudo asks. Existing server SSH authentication rules also apply to this account.
db_confirm_create: Create database {database}. You can add users afterwards.
db_external_hint: This database was not created by MOS. Inventory is available; its users and permissions remain externally managed.
db_tables_hint: Row counts are estimates. Sizes are in bytes. PostgreSQL automatic grants cover the public schema.
db_confirm_delete: Delete {database} and its data. This can break the website. A local SQL backup must succeed first; it does not replace an off-host backup. Active PostgreSQL connections are not terminated.
db_user_existing: Grant access to an existing MOS user
db_read_hint: Query tables and views. No data changes or table creation.
db_write_hint: Read, insert, update and delete rows. No schema changes.
db_admin_hint: Change data and structure in this database. No sudo or engine superuser privileges.
db_confirm_user: User {username} → database {database}: {role}. Local access. Reconnect clients after permission changes.
db_no_other_users: No other additional MOS users exist in this engine.
db_reveal_warning: The password will be displayed. Avoid screen recording or sharing this screen.
db_password_warning: Change the password for {username}. This affects all its databases. Update application credentials manually.
db_confirm_revoke: Revoke {username} access to {database}. Keep the account and its other database grants. Reconnect clients.
db_confirm_user_delete: Delete {username} from this engine and ALL its databases. Applications using this account will lose access.
db_primary_protected: The primary site user cannot be removed or have privileges reduced here. Its password can be rotated.
db_exists: A database or account with that name already exists. It was not replaced.
db_user_exists: This username already exists or is reserved. Use another name.
db_invalid_role: Invalid permission profile or unmanaged account.
db_unmanaged: Only databases and users registered by MOS can be changed.
db_credentials_missing: No valid credential file is available for this account.
db_command_failed: The database engine rejected the operation. Check installation, service status, active connections and object dependencies. Statements that could contain passwords are not displayed.
db_role_cleanup_warning: The database was removed, but internal roles with external dependencies remain. Review the operation log.
